messages:
Sanjay Patel: Quick sync — partners asked for a consolidated slotting heatmap for H200/H100, MI300, Gaudi. Can we get a status? TL;DR: where are embargo windows & fallback model variants?
Olivia Chen: Working on the heatmap. Need last 2-week capacity from hw-ops + marketplace. @Mike R. can you confirm H200 availability in APAC (ap-southeast)?
Mike R.: H200 shipping looks OK but we have a microcode hold on a subset of SKUs; vendor promises a patch by next Wed. If that slips, fallback to H100 or B200 may be needed. Pulling the affected list now.
Jamie: Also confirm press/embargo asks — partners want a 2-week hands-off window before public announce. Need to align with marketplace commit dates.
Partner Rep - H: Confirming microcode patch ETA Wed 2026-04-15. We'll publish a CV image tag and release notes once validated. Will post tag & test vectors here.
Olivia Chen: Great. For MI300: @Partner Rep - Gaudi, any thermal or perf constraints on early batches that would affect slotting?
Partner Rep - Gaudi: MI300 early runs show ~10% lower throughput at 48k seq due to memcfg corner case; a firmware/build fix is inbound but may mean smaller initial capacity. We'll share a perf-delta matrix and recommended SKU gating.
Sanjay Patel: Ok capturing action items. Proposed fallback policy draft: route by compatibility/cost: H200 -> H100 -> B200; MI300 -> quantized MI300 variant -> fallback to B200 in other region. Keep automatic fallback for 503/overload only, not for perf regressions.
Mike R.: +1. Add a mandatory canary TTL: 48h smoke + perf run (p999 latency, throughput) before lifting embargo for public traffic. Also require image tag on the marketplace side.
Jamie: I'm building the heatmap now. Deliverables I'm tracking: (1) slotting map update (2) embargo window calendar (3) fallback policy doc (4) SI integrator notice with integration checklist. I'll ping SI channel once matrix is ready.
Olivia Chen: I can assemble a partner one-pager with perf deltas + canary checklist. Anything else to include? Example canary curl we can give partners: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/inst/serve -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"h100-v1","seq_len":2048,"requests":100}'```
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline triggered by @Jamie — job #4821 started.
Sanjay Patel: Thanks team. Jamie pls drop heatmap here by EOD tomorrow. Olivia to draft one-pager by Friday COB. I'll coordinate cross-org announcement slot and embargo handshake with legal. :thumbsup:
